title: Madden NFL 97
overview:
NFL Football Madden Style!

Features

Real NFL Football
- Full NFL Season, Playoffs, Super Bowl, and Pro Bowl
- Over 100 NFL teams
- NFL Player Rosters
- Over 500 Madden-Designed Plays
- 31 3-D Rendered NFL stadiums
- 10 Real NFL Penalties

32-Bit Power
- TV-style presentation: Live play-by-play with Madden and Summerall, plus James Brown in the studio
- Motion Capture Graphics and Animations
- Multiple camera angles
- Create and Trade players
- Player and Team stats in over 60 categories
